end.summary:
Practised number pairs that make 100 using tens and two-digit numbers.
Answered 30 + 70, 40 + 60, and 20 + 80 correctly.
Used number-line jumps of 1 and 10 toward 100.
The jump of 10 from 65 was still stated as landing on 70; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised making 100 with partner numbers and describing jumps on a number line. The method of using the remaining amount worked for several tens examples, and they corrected one statement about 60 + 40 during the lesson. The mix-up about a jump of 10 from 65 landing on 70 was not corrected by the end. At home, use a number line to practise jumps of 10 from numbers such as 35, 65, and 82, saying each landing number aloud.
